name: figma sprint
context: Every design sprint at the Studio: from the project's stated direction to the agreed result handed off as design debt.
compromises: a no at approve_start stops the run; there is no earlier step worth sending it back to
a retry of a failed step cannot be drawn: if one option cannot be built, the run stops and says which
the Designer can change the Figma file at any time and the Studio re-reads it before every write; here it is read again only when a no from approve_choice sends the work back to read_canvas
a removal needs a listed set and the Designer's yes before it happens; that rule is not drawn
the loop-back limit of 3 rounds at each approval was proposed when the graph was drawn and the Designer has not confirmed it

two steps are the graph author's reading of the skill, not something it says in so many words: approve_start (confirming the direction and the Figma file before any visual work) and read_canvas (a read of the file before the options are planned)

nodes.job: read the project's DESIGN.md and its stated direction
open the Figma file that DESIGN.md names
confirm the direction and the Figma file are the right ones, or say what to start from
write the one-sentence change this sprint tests, and the direction summary
try to break the change: more than one concern, or a decision outside the direction
read the change and say yes or no to testing it
read the scoped part of the Figma file as it stands, with the Designer's own changes kept
decide the design options to compare, each differing from the baseline only in the tested change
build one option as a labelled frame inside the sprint section
try to break one option: it differs from the baseline in more than the tested change, sits outside the section, or lacks a state label
place the checked options in the sprint section left to right in the order explored, each with its state label
read the sprint page, tweak it, and say which option is agreed
write the agreed result as design debt, naming what stays rejected and why
try to break the handoff: anything claimed as shipped, or an approved item changed without a yes
